memo.headline: AI Inference shows latent standalone demand, but revenue usage lags the threshold; diagnose why standalone deals are lost before investing.
memo.memo:
Behavioral: 141 accounts use AI Inference (35.2% adoption). Standalone usage share is 20.0% of revenue, 5.0 pts below the effective threshold of 25.0%. That threshold was lowered from 30.0% because self-serve converts to paid without voice at 12.2%. This is the sensitive call. Twelve-month retention is 80.7% for standalone (n=31) and 72.2% for attached (n=18). Both samples are small. Gross margin is 30.0% for both.

Pipeline: 11 of 50 transcripts frame it as standalone (22.0% demand share). 72.7% of those are buyer-initiated. Standalone win rate is 40.0% (10 closed deals), against 66.7% bundled. Top loss concerns are price, model breadth and compliance. Main competitors are Fireworks, Together AI and OpenAI.

Self-serve: 210 signups. The 90-day paid rate is 23.8% with voice and 12.2% without.

Stated versus revealed: of 4 won accounts that said standalone, 50.0% mostly use Voice AI.

What would change the call: usage share clearing the threshold would favor doubling down. If the gap holds after loss diagnosis, treat it as a Voice AI component.

Next action: run a loss review on price, model breadth and compliance against the named competitors. All data is synthetic.
